name: agent-advisor-codex
description: Agent Advisor for Codex: Sol / High declares solo, delegate, audit, or exceptional full delivery before work begins.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with Sol / High, declare a risk-gated route, and use at most one auxiliary by default.
interface.longDescription: Agent Advisor for Codex keeps GPT-5.6 Sol / High in the primary session for architecture, implementation when solo or audit is selected, verification, and acceptance. Before the first task tool call, Sol declares a machine-auditable SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; delegate uses native GPT-5.6 Luna / Max for bounded work or GPT-5.6 Terra / High for higher-risk work; audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-5.6 Sol / High review; full combines one selected implementer with a fresh review only for a broad or high-risk exception. Observed primary metadata is authoritative; a bundled first-call inspector verifies user-level provenance before a standing attestation may fill unobservable primary fields, while conflicting primary or missing auxiliary routing evidence fails closed.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-advisor-codex:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
